item_short_desc: Rothco’s Chemical Lightsticks come in a convenient 10-pack, offering a reliable source of light for up to 12 hours. Available in assorted colors, these lightsticks are perfect for emergencies, camping, or outdoor activities where dependable illumination is needed. Each lightstick emits a steady glow, providing bright, hands-free lighting in low-visibility conditions. The lightsticks are easy to use—simply bend, snap, and shake for an instant, long-lasting glow.
description: Rothco’s Chemical Lightsticks come in a convenient 10-pack, offering a reliable source of light for up to 12 hours. Available in assorted colors, these lightsticks are perfect for emergencies, camping, or outdoor activities where dependable illumination is needed. Each lightstick emits a steady glow, providing bright, hands-free lighting in low-visibility conditions. The lightsticks are easy to use—simply bend, snap, and shake for an instant, long-lasting glow. Ideal for a variety of situations, they are great for keeping in your emergency preparedness kit, bringing along on camping trips, or using for outdoor events such as Halloween or night hiking. Tested and certified for safety, Rothco’s Chemical Lightsticks are designed to meet rigorous standards, making them an essential tool for your lighting needs.
